adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Manipulating long sticks made of agricultural residue
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Processional movement through village streets and house courtyards
movement_profile.partnering: None; individual characters in a troupe
movement_profile.posture: Upright but heavy due to the weight of the grass and mask

signature_moves.description: The lead character (old woman) walks at the front of the troupe using a support stick.
signature_moves.name: Thamma's Walk

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid disrespecting the masks as they represent deities; ensure the grass suit does not obstruct movement in narrow spaces.

music_profile.musical_form: Episodic songs based on Ramayana and folk tales
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Vibrating string pulses created by striking a bow with bamboo
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the unique, resonant vibration of the Onavillu, a wooden bow whose string is struck to create a rhythmic drone. This is accompanied by the chanting or singing of mythological verses.

basic_steps: Don the grass suit and wooden mask
Follow the lead of the Thamma character
Step in rhythm with the Onavillu bow vibration
Process from house to house in a communal line
teaching.formation: Processional; moving from house to house
teaching.level_notes: Requires physical endurance to carry heavy wooden masks and thick grass costumes.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythm provided by the vibrating string of the Onavillu bow
